title: Private Pay Long-Term Care Residency: Personal Item Charges Secured by a Resumption Deposit
content:
**Ancillary item charges guidance — Private Pay Long-Term Care Residency.** The resumption personal-item allowance is read from the item charges posted to the resident's **Ancillary and Optional Services Billing** account within the last three months (entries dated fewer than three whole calendar months before the day the resumption deposit is worked out).

- Three or more item charges: their total divided by three.
- One or two: the latest item charge, the one posted first where two share a posting date.
- None: no allowance.

**Hypothetical cases, at the published ancillary prices.** A permanent wave at 68.00, a guest dinner at 11.75, a wash and set at 28.00 and a barber shave at 12.00: 119.75 divided by three, 39.9166…, carried unrounded into the deposit, which is rounded once on its final figure. Two charges, a guest breakfast at 6.75 and then a hair color at 54.00: 54.00.
